This file constructs the data needed for modeling, then saves the result as allData.RData, so you would just need to execute Modelling.qmd

```{r}
# Installing pacman
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
#Loading packages, install if necessary
pacman::p_load(readxl, quantmod)

#importing excel sheet
#Data: Robert Shiller, Yale university
#S&P Composite Stock Price Index, dividends, earnings
#http://www.econ.yale.edu/~shiller/data.htm
ie_data <- read_excel("data/ie_data.xls", 
    sheet = "Data", range = "A8:P1872", col_types = c("text", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "text", "numeric", 
        "text", "numeric"))

# get wholesale price index from FRED
getSymbols("PPIACO", src = "FRED")
wpi <- PPIACO["1926-03-01/2026-03-01"]

ie_data$Date <- seq(from = as.Date("1871-01-01"), 
                    to = as.Date("2026-04-01"), 
                    by = "month")
df <- ie_data[ie_data$Date >= as.Date("1926-03-01") &
                ie_data$Date <= as.Date("2026-03-01"),]

price <- df$P
dividend <- df$D
log_price <- log(price)
log_dividend <- log(dividend)

save.image("allData.RData")


```
